Class PoolLink.Ear

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.pool.PoolLink.Ear
All Implemented Interfaces:
WebSocket.Listener
Enclosing class:
PoolLink
private static final class PoolLink.Ear extends Object implements WebSocket.Listener
The Ear class receives WebSocket text and offers each complete frame to the line stream. A fragmented frame is joined until last is true. The next message is requested after each event.
Author:
clayl (2026-11-08)

    • onError

      public void onError(WebSocket webSocket, Throwable error)
      The onError method ends the line stream. The error text is not logged, so a token on a failed handshake is not written out.
      Specified by:
      onError in interface WebSocket.Listener
      Parameters:
      webSocket - The socket has failed.
      error - The error is the failure. Its message is not logged.
